component.dynamic_color_path: Aurorae uses DecorationOptions.titleBarColor; Surface.qml derives the historical light/shadow relationship with Palette.tone. DomainOS reference colors are retained as measured baselines for that transform.

qt_surface_input_render.coverage: active/inactive border and button crops; title press/release, controls and native input event behavior

private_kwin_native_actions.coverage: thick resizable frame, thin fixed dialog, title relief held/released, move/resize, menu and native actions

native_kdecoration_preview.console_note: Qt printed QSettings empty-key and KDecoration module-identifier diagnostics; the structured report recorded zero QML warnings and all checks passed.

integrated_panel_palette_matrix.result: Integrated Plasma/KWin panel responded to all three test schemes and private XDG was restored to DomainOS-SR10-4. This is not cross-family coverage.

limits: Only the window decoration component was revalidated for V10; menus, panels and toolkits were not collectively captured in this run.
V02-V09 remain partial or blocked, including the Qt Quick painter path and panel consumer evidence.
A panel-only matrix in isolated Xephyr now covers DomainOS, neutral, dark and yellow; the integrated suite across current consumers remains incomplete.
Maximized layout is a KDE adaptation and is not visible in the reference image.
Technical comparison is not user visual acceptance.
